packageRules.description: Everything in devDependencies except lit is build/lint/test tooling, safe to automerge on green CI. lit is excluded here: it is bundled into glp-card.js, so it is a runtime dependency even though it sits in devDependencies (see the lit rule below).

lit is bundled into glp-card.js by npm run build, so it ships to users as the card's runtime templating library even though it is declared in devDependencies. A bad release breaks the rendered card, so this rule deliberately has no automerge and updates are reviewed by hand.

github/codeql-action's init/analyze/upload-sarif sub-actions ship from one release train and must stay version-matched, or the Analyze job fails on the mismatch (PR #81, run 31450429543, and #109/#110).
Every other action is CI-only, ungrouped is fine — safe to automerge on green.
